mapper.select: SELECT ddovyo.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.version, t.user_source, t.register_dates, t.register_day, t.retention_user_num FROM (select lr.dates, lr.pkg, lr.register_version version, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Organic') user_source, lr.register_dates, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, lr.register_dates, lr.dates) register_day, count(DISTINCT lr.user_id) retention_user_num from dwd_user_login_record lr left join dim_user_source dus on (lr.user_id = dus.user_id) where dates = #{dates} group by lr.dates, lr.pkg, lr.register_version, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Organic'), lr.register_dates) t left join dws_daily_pkg_ver_usrc_retention ddovyo on (t.dates = ddovyo.dates and t.pkg = ddovyo.pkg and t.version = ddovyo.version and t.user_source = ddovyo.user_source and t.register_dates = ddovyo.register_dates)
